help.output:
Skill manager and local work handoff for coding agents.

Run without a command to see every skill and how it lines up across your agents.

Usage: gandalf [OPTIONS] [COMMAND]

Commands:
  skill     See and manage skills across Claude Code, Codex, and Cursor
  init      Connect Claude Code and Codex and install the background service
  status    Show whether the background service is ready
  doctor    Check the local installation for problems
  daemon    Start, stop, or inspect the background service
  agent     List, connect, or disconnect agents
  work      List and show tracked work in this project
  handoff   Print the handoff contract for one piece of work
  evidence  Show one piece of recorded evidence
  search    Search tracked work in this project
  tui       Browse tracked work in a terminal UI
  mcp       Serve handoff context to an agent over MCP (stdio)
  config    Show or change settings
  forget    Delete recorded work or all data for this project
  help      Print this message or the help of the given subcommand(s)

Options:
      --output <OUTPUT>
          [default: text]
          [possible values: text, json]

      --project-root <PROJECT_ROOT>
          

  -h, --help
          Print help (see a summary with '-h')

  -V, --version
          Print version
